fields.reported: Amplitude/cell ratios are supplied beside inherited dimpling margins.
fields.checked: Those ratios do not identify wavelength or mode separation. CR-1457 explicitly allows dimples to precipitate wrinkling. Dimpling uses a different biaxial factor (0.5) from wrinkling's cubic root.
fields.followup: Measure the directional waveform spectrum and use a coupled assessment or matching experiment; do not apply the wrinkling multiplier to the dimpling formula.
